description: Returns the goods one Forever vendor sells, by the vendor's NPC id, each with the copper price players saw. An item is listed when 3 installs agree on that item and its copper price; two agreed prices both stay listed. No copied catalog. Use it for what a vendor sells and at what price; use npc_page for where the vendor stands, entity_relations with the sold_by relation for who sells an item, and market_value for auction prices. The id is the same NPC id npc_page takes. Reads Everloot's public player data when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.

vendorNpcId.description: The vendor's NPC id, the id npc_page takes, from world_map_near or entity_relations.

name: vendor_page

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

limitedStock.description: Null with unlimited false means the stock is unrecorded, not unlimited.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Vendor page
